facts.text: Lawrence University maintains Björklunden vid Sjön, a 441-acre North Campus in Door County, Wisconsin, featuring meadows, woods, and more than a mile of unspoiled Lake Michigan shoreline.

sources.title: Björklunden - Lawrence University
sources.quote: Björklunden vid Sjön is Lawrence University's 441-acre North Campus. A sanctuary of peace and contemplation, Björklunden resides in picturesque Door County, Wisconsin and features meadows, woods, and more than a mile of unspoiled Lake Michigan shoreline.
